069/**
070 * Represents a single Java servlet/resource method annotated with {@link RestOp @RestOp}.
071 *
072 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
073 *    <li class='note'>This class is thread safe and reusable.
074 * </ul>
075 *
076 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
077 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/RestOpContext">RestOpContext</a>
078 * </ul>
079 */
080@SuppressWarnings({
081   "java:S112", // throws Exception intentional - callback/lifecycle methods throughout this class
082   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
083   "java:S1200", // High coupling is intentional in this central operation context aggregator.
084   "java:S3776", // Branching is inherent to the RestOpContext constructor and compareTo(), which resolve many annotation-driven settings and ordering keys.
085   "java:S6539", // RestOpContext intentionally centralizes op wiring and annotation resolution.
086   "rawtypes", // Raw types necessary for generic type handling.
087   "resource", // op-level BasicBeanStores are short-lived scratch stores; the long-lived opBeanStore field is owned and closed by the parent RestContext via its bean-store hierarchy.
088   "unchecked" // Cast is safe: type parameter is verified by caller context.
089})
090public class RestOpContext extends Context implements Comparable<RestOpContext> {

096   /**
097    * Env-driven default charset for this operation, populated by {@link ClassInfo#inject(Object, BeanStore)}

100    */
101   @Value("${RestContext.defaultCharset:UTF-8}")
102   private String defaultCharsetName;

104   /**
105    * Env-driven default max-input string for this operation, populated by {@link ClassInfo#inject(Object, BeanStore)}
106    * before the {@link #maxInput} memoizer fires; resolved from {@code RestContext.maxInput} or
107    * {@code "1000000"} &mdash; matching the {@code @Rest}-level fallback in
108    * {@link org.apache.juneau.rest.server.config.DefaultConfig DefaultConfig} so an operation that falls all the
109    * way through to this last-resort default doesn't end up with a substantially larger effective ceiling than
110    * the class-level default.
111    */
112   @Value("${RestContext.maxInput:1000000}")
113   private String defaultMaxInputString;

115   /**
116    * Internal construction-time state holder.
117    */
118   static class Builder extends Context.Builder {
119
120      private Method restMethod;
121      private RestContext restContext;
122      private Supplier<Object> restResourceSupplier;
123
124      Builder(Method method, RestContext context) {
125         this(method, context, null);
126      }
127
128      Builder(Method method, RestContext context, Supplier<Object> resourceSupplier) {
129
130         this.restContext = context;
131         this.restMethod = method;
132         this.restResourceSupplier = resourceSupplier == null ? context::getResource : resourceSupplier;
133
134         var ap = context.getMarshallingContext().getAnnotationProvider();
135         var mi = MethodInfo.of(context.getResourceClass(), method);
136         var resourceClass = ClassInfo.of(context.getResourceClass());
137
138         try {
139            var vr = context.getVarResolver();
140            var vrs = vr.createSession();
141
142            // Parent-to-child merge: class-level annotations (parent class chain) applied first, then method-level
143            // (matching-methods chain, return type, package). Method annotations thus override class annotations
144            // for the same property. LinkedHashSet deduplicates while preserving order.
145            //
146            // For a mixin op (the op's context is a mixin sub-context), the host's class-level @ContextApply
147            // config (e.g. @HtmlDocConfig, @SerializerConfig) is prepended ahead of the mixin class's own class
148            // annotations, so the effective precedence is method > mixin-class > host-class. This is the
149            // op-level counterpart of the context-level inheritance walk and is gated by @Rest(noInherit) on
150            // the mixin. For non-mixin contexts the host stream is empty (no behavior change).
151            var hostClassAnnotations = context.getInheritedHostClassAnnotations(ap);
152            var declaringClassAnnotations = rstream(ap.find(resourceClass, SELF, PARENTS));
153            var methodAnnotations = rstream(ap.find(mi, SELF, MATCHING_METHODS, RETURN_TYPE, PACKAGE));
154            var allAnnotationsSet = new LinkedHashSet<AnnotationInfo<?>>();
155            hostClassAnnotations.forEach(allAnnotationsSet::add);
156            declaringClassAnnotations.forEach(allAnnotationsSet::add);
157            methodAnnotations.forEach(allAnnotationsSet::add);
158            var work = AnnotationWorkList.of(vrs, allAnnotationsSet.stream().filter(CONTEXT_APPLY_FILTER));
159
160            apply(work);
161
162         } catch (Exception e) {
163            throw new InternalServerError(e);
164         }
165      }
166
167      @Override /* Overridden from Context.Builder<?> */
168      public Builder copy() {
169         throw new NoSuchMethodError("Not implemented.");
170      }
171   }
172
173   private static HttpPartSerializer createPartSerializer(Class<? extends HttpPartSerializer> c, HttpPartSerializer defaultSerializer) {
174      return c == null
175         ? defaultSerializer
176         : BeanInstantiator.of(HttpPartSerializer.class).type(c).fallback(() -> defaultSerializer).run();
177   }

221      var p = "allowedParserOptions";
222      if (isInherited(p))
223         l.addAll(restContext().getAllowedParserOptions());
224      getRestOpAnnotations().stream()

226         .forEach(l::add);

242   /** The {@link MarshallingContext} for this operation (op-level annotations applied on top of the parent context). */
243   private final Memoizer<MarshallingContext> marshallingContext = memoizer(() -> {
244      var aa = appliedAnnotations();
245      var parent = restContext().getBeanContextBuilder();
246      if (!parent.canApply(aa))
247         return restContext().getMarshallingContext();
248      Holder<MarshallingContext.Builder> v = Holder.of(parent.copy());
249      v.get().apply(aa);
250      var bs = new BasicBeanStore(beanStore())
251         .addBean(Method.class, method())
252         .addBean(MarshallingContext.Builder.class, v.get());
253      bs.createBeanFromMethod(MarshallingContext.class, resource(), this::matchesInjectScope)
254         .ifPresent(x -> v.get().impl(x));
255      return v.get().build();
256   });
257
258   /**
259    * The per-operation logger for debug capture.
260    *
261    * <p>
262    * A hierarchical child of the <b>host</b> resource's {@linkplain RestContext#getLogger() resolved logger}
263    * ({@code <hostLoggerName>.<methodName>}) so an operator can raise the debug level for a single operation
264    * without affecting its siblings (JUL parent-level inheritance). Deriving from the resolved logger &mdash;
265    * rather than the raw resource class name &mdash; means a bean-store {@code RichLogger} override on the host
266    * (see {@link RestContext#getLogger()}) is honored: the op logger is a true JUL child of whatever logger the
267    * host actually resolves to, not a same-named-but-unrelated sibling.
268    *
269    * <p>
270    * For an operation contributed by a composed {@linkplain Rest#mixins() mixin}, the host is the <b>host /
271    * top-level resource</b> &mdash; not the mixin class &mdash; so raising the host resource's JUL level cascades
272    * to its mixin-served operations, and the same mixin composed into different hosts resolves to distinct,
273    * host-isolated loggers.  Non-mixin operations (including child resources, which are their own resources)
274    * resolve to their own resource's logger as before.
275    */
276   private final Memoizer<RichLogger> logger = memoizer(() ->
277      RichLogger.getLogger(hostRestContext().getLogger().getName() + "." + getJavaMethod().getName()));
278
279   /**
280    * Returns the host / top-level resource context for logger naming.
281    *
282    * <p>
283    * When this operation's context originates from a {@linkplain RestContext#isMixinContext() mixin sub-context},
284    * walks up the {@linkplain RestContext#getParentContext() parent-context} linkage past any composed mixin
285    * sub-contexts to the host resource that composed the mixin.  Non-mixin contexts (including child resources)
286    * return their own context unchanged.
287    *
288    * @return The host resource context.
289    */
290   private RestContext hostRestContext() {
291      var rc = restContext();
292      while (rc.isMixinContext() && rc.getParentContext() != null)
293         rc = rc.getParentContext();
294      return rc;
295   }

297   /**
298    * The response-converter array for this operation.
299    *
300    * <p>
301    * Walks the {@code @Rest(converters)} class chain (parent-to-child) followed by the
302    * {@code @RestOp(converters)} method chain (parent-to-child). Op-level
303    * {@code noInherit={"converters"}} cuts off the class-chain contribution. An
304    * {@code @Bean RestConverterList} bean (either as a name-anonymous bean in the bean store
305    * or as a {@code @Bean} method whose {@code methodScope} matches this operation's method
306    * name) REPLACES the entire annotation-derived list.
307    */
308   private final Memoizer<RestConverter[]> converters = memoizer(() -> {
309      var bs = beanStore();
310      var b = RestConverterList.create(bs);
311      if (isInherited("converters"))
312         restContext().getRestAnnotationsForProperty("converters")
313            .forEach(ai -> b.append(ai.inner().converters()));
314      getRestOpAnnotationsForProperty("converters")
315         .forEach(ai -> ai.getClassArray("converters", RestConverter.class).ifPresent(classes -> {
316            for (var c : classes)
317               b.append(classArray(c));
318         }));
319      var override = bs.createBeanFromMethod(RestConverterList.class, resource(), this::matchesInjectScope).orElse(null);
320      if (override == null)
321         override = bs.getBean(RestConverterList.class).orElse(null);
322      return (nn(override) ? override : b.build()).asArray();
323   });

325   /** The effective default {@link Charset} for this operation, resolved from op annotations, context, or env. */
326   private final Memoizer<Charset> defaultCharset = memoizer(() -> {
327      var v = findOpString("defaultCharset");
328      if (v.isPresent())
329         return Charset.forName(v.get());
330      if (isInherited("defaultCharset")) {
331         var rv = restContext().mergeReplacedStringAttribute("defaultCharset", null);
332         if (ine(rv))
333            return Charset.forName(rv);
334      }
335      return Charset.forName(defaultCharsetName);
336   });

338   /**
339    * The default request attribute map for this operation.
340    *
341    * <p>
342    * Starts with the class-level value (which already incorporates
343    * {@code @Rest(defaultRequestAttributes)}), then walks the {@code @RestOp}/verb chain
344    * (parent-to-child) and adds each entry — {@link NamedAttributeMap#add} uses put-semantics so
345    * child entries override parent entries by name. An
346    * {@code @Bean(name="defaultRequestAttributes") NamedAttributeMap} bean (matching this
347    * operation's method scope) REPLACES the entire result.
348    */
349   private final Memoizer<NamedAttributeMap> defaultRequestAttributes = memoizer(() -> {
350      var v = Holder.of(restContext().getDefaultRequestAttributes().copy());
351      getRestOpAnnotationsForProperty("defaultRequestAttributes").forEach(ai -> {
352         for (var s : ai.getStringArray("defaultRequestAttributes").orElse(EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY))
353            v.get().add(BasicNamedAttribute.ofPair(s));
354      });
355      beanStore().createBeanFromMethod(NamedAttributeMap.class, resource(), x -> matchesInjectScope(x, "defaultRequestAttributes"))
356         .ifPresent(v::set);
357      return v.get();
358   });

360   /**
361    * The default request form-data parts for this operation.
362    *
363    * <p>
364    * Walks the {@code @RestOp}/verb chain (parent-to-child); each {@code defaultRequestFormData}
365    * entry is applied with {@link PartList#setDefault} (first-in-chain wins per name).
366    * Method-parameter {@link FormData @FormData} annotations with a
367    * {@link Schema#default_()}/{@link Schema#df()} default are folded in last (also
368    * {@code setDefault} = first wins). An {@code @Bean(name="defaultRequestFormData") PartList}
369    * bean (matching this operation's method scope) REPLACES the entire result.
370    */
371   private final Memoizer<HttpPartList> defaultRequestFormData = memoizer(() -> {
372      var v = Holder.of(HttpPartList.create());
373      getRestOpAnnotationsForProperty("defaultRequestFormData").forEach(ai -> {
374         for (var s : ai.getStringArray("defaultRequestFormData").orElse(EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY))
375            v.get().setDefault(HttpStringPart.ofPair(s));
376      });
377      processParameterDefaults((paramAnn, def) -> {
378         if (paramAnn instanceof FormData paramAnn2) {
379            try {
380               v.get().setDefault(HttpStringPart.of(firstNonEmpty(paramAnn2.name(), paramAnn2.value()), toPartValue(parseIfJson(def))));
381            } catch (ParseException e) {
382               throw new ConfigException(e, "Malformed @FormData annotation");
383            }
384         }
385      });
386      beanStore().createBeanFromMethod(HttpPartList.class, resource(), x -> matchesInjectScope(x, "defaultRequestFormData"))
387         .ifPresent(v::set);
388      return v.get();
389   });
390
391   /**
392    * The default request headers for this operation.
393    *
394    * <p>
395    * Starts with the class-level value (which already incorporates
396    * {@code @Rest(defaultRequestHeaders|defaultAccept|defaultContentType)}), then walks the
397    * {@code @RestOp}/verb chain (parent-to-child); each annotation's {@code defaultRequestHeaders}
398    * entries plus its {@code defaultAccept} / {@code defaultContentType} (folded into
399    * {@code Accept} / {@code Content-Type} headers) are applied with {@link HeaderList#setDefault}
400    * (first-in-chain wins per name — class-level beats op-level beats later op-level entries).
401    *
402    * <p>
403    * Method-parameter {@link Header @Header} annotations with a
404    * {@link Schema#default_()}/{@link Schema#df()} default are folded in last via
405    * {@link HeaderList#set} (overrides any prior entry with the same name). An
406    * {@code @Bean(name="defaultRequestHeaders") HeaderList} bean (matching this operation's
407    * method scope) REPLACES the entire result.
408    */
409   private final Memoizer<HttpHeaderList> defaultRequestHeaders = memoizer(() -> {
410      var v = Holder.of(restContext().getDefaultRequestHeaders().copy());
411      getRestOpAnnotationsForProperty("defaultRequestHeaders").forEach(ai -> {
412         for (var s : ai.getStringArray("defaultRequestHeaders").orElse(EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY))
413            v.get().setDefault(HttpStringHeader.ofPair(s));
414         ai.getString("defaultAccept").filter(s -> !s.isEmpty()).ifPresent(s -> v.get().setDefault(Accept.of(s)));
415         ai.getString("defaultContentType").filter(s -> !s.isEmpty()).ifPresent(s -> v.get().setDefault(ContentType.of(s)));
416      });
417      processParameterDefaults((paramAnn, def) -> {
418         if (paramAnn instanceof Header paramAnn2) {
419            try {
420               v.get().set(HttpStringHeader.of(firstNonEmpty(paramAnn2.name(), paramAnn2.value()), toPartValue(parseIfJson(def))));
421            } catch (ParseException e) {
422               throw new ConfigException(e, "Malformed @Header annotation");
423            }
424         }
425      });
426      beanStore().createBeanFromMethod(HttpHeaderList.class, resource(), x -> matchesInjectScope(x, "defaultRequestHeaders"))
427         .ifPresent(v::set);
428      return v.get();
429   });

491    * semantics). Falls through to the class-level {@link RestContext#getEncoders()} when no op
492    * annotation declares encoders. An {@code @Bean EncoderSet} bean (matching this operation's

509   /**
510    * The request-guard array for this operation. <b>Cross-bucket memoizer</b> — folds three
511    * annotation attributes ({@code guards}, {@code roleGuard}, {@code rolesDeclared}) into a
512    * single effective {@link RestGuardList}.
513    *
514    * <p>
515    * Walk order: class {@code @Rest} chain (parent-to-child, gated by op-level
516    * {@code noInherit={"guards"}}), then op {@code @RestOp} chain (parent-to-child). Concretely:
517    * <ul>
518    *    <li>Each annotation contributes its {@code guards()} classes (appended in chain order).
519    *    <li>Each annotation contributes its {@code rolesDeclared()} CDL into a single role-name set.
520    *    <li>Each annotation contributes its {@code roleGuard()} string (when non-blank). Each
521    *       non-blank {@code roleGuard} becomes a {@link RoleBasedRestGuard} appended to the list,
522    *       using the accumulated {@code rolesDeclared} set as its allow-list.
523    * </ul>
524    *
525    * <p>

937    * superset of the previous behavior. Path strings whose entire SVL resolution yields an empty

940    * registered {@link Var}) pass through to {@link UrlPathMatcher#of} as the literal {@code ${...}}

990         else if (methodInfo2.hasAnnotation(RestPost.class))
991            httpMethod2 = "post";
992         else if (methodInfo2.hasAnnotation(RestDelete.class))
993            httpMethod2 = "delete";
994         else if (methodInfo2.hasAnnotation(RestOp.class)) {

1079   /**
1080    * The serializer group for this operation.
1081    *
1082    * <p>
1083    * Walks the {@code @RestOp(serializers)} chain (parent-to-child); the most-derived non-empty
1084    * {@code serializers()} array REPLACES the entire inherited set. Falls through to the class-level
1085    * {@link RestContext#getSerializers()} when no op annotation declares serializers. An
1086    * {@code @Bean SerializerSet} bean (matching this operation's method scope) REPLACES the result.
1087    */

1096         var c = ai.getClassArray("serializers", Serializer.class).orElse(null);
1097         if (nn(c) && c.length > 0)
1098            b.set(c);
1099      });
1100      var result = Holder.of(b.build());
1101      bs.createBeanFromMethod(SerializerSet.class, resource(), this::matchesInjectScope)
1102         .ifPresent(result::set);
1103      return result.get();
1104   });

1136   /**

1138    * {@link Schema#default_()}/{@link Schema#df()} string (joined-non-blank-first) and dispatching
1139    * each annotation+default pair to the supplied callback.
1140    */
1141   private void processParameterDefaults(BiConsumer<Annotation,String> callback) {
1142      for (var aa : method.getParameterAnnotations()) {
1143         String def = null;

1145            if (a instanceof Schema a2)
1146               def = joinnlFirstNonEmptyArray(a2.default_(), a2.df());
1147         }
1148         if (def == null)
1149            continue;
1150         for (var a : aa)
1151            callback.accept(a, def);
1152      }

1155   /**
1156    * Returns {@code true} if the given method has a {@code @Bean} annotation whose
1157    * {@code methodScope} includes this operation's method name (or {@code "*"}).
1158    *
1159    * <p>
1160    * Used by op-level memoizers when scanning the resource class for {@code @Bean}-supplied
1161    * composite-bean overrides ({@code RestConverterList}, {@code RestGuardList}, etc.). This is the
1162    * {@link RestOpContext}-scope peer of {@link Builder#matches(MethodInfo)} — kept in sync with that
1163    * one.
1164    */
1165   private boolean matchesInjectScope(MethodInfo annotated) {
1166      var a = annotated.getAnnotations(Bean.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null);
1167      if (a != null) {
1168         for (var n : a.methodScope()) {
1169            if (eq(n, "*") || method.getName().equals(n))
1170               return true;
1171         }
1172      }
1173      return false;
1174   }
1175
1176   /**
1177    * Same as {@link #matchesInjectScope(MethodInfo)} but additionally requires the
1178    * {@link Bean#name()} attribute to equal {@code beanName}.
1179    *
1180    * <p>
1181    * Used for named composite-bean overrides ({@code defaultRequestHeaders}, {@code defaultResponseHeaders},
1182    * etc.) where the bean type alone is ambiguous (e.g. {@link HeaderList} appears as both request and
1183    * response headers).
1184    */
1185   private boolean matchesInjectScope(MethodInfo annotated, String beanName) {
1186      var a = annotated.getAnnotations(Bean.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null);
1187      if (a != null) {
1188         if (! BeanAnnotation.name(a).equals(beanName))
1189            return false;
1190         for (var n : a.methodScope()) {
1191            if (eq(n, "*") || method.getName().equals(n))
1192               return true;
1193         }
1194      }
1195      return false;
1196   }

1198   private Stream<String> resolveCdl(String...values) {
1199      if (values == null || values.length == 0)
1200         return Stream.empty();
1201      return Arrays.stream(values)
1202         .filter(Objects::nonNull)
1203         .map(s -> RestOpContext.this.context.getVarResolver().resolve(s))
1204         .map(StringUtils::split)
1205         .flatMap(Collection::stream)
1206         .map(String::trim)
1207         .filter(StringUtils::isNotBlank);
1208   }

1219   /**
1220    * Returns the {@link RestOp}-group annotations on this method for the specified property,
1221    * in <b>parent-to-child</b> order, with op-level {@code noInherit} cutoff applied.
1222    *
1223    * <p>
1224    * Mirrors {@link RestContext#getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)} but for the op-level chain. Used by
1225    * op-level memoizers ({@link #converters}, {@link #guards}, {@link #matchersList},
1226    * {@link #encoders}, etc.) when accumulating values from each {@code @RestOp} / {@code @RestGet} /
1227    * {@code @RestPut} / {@code @RestPost} / {@code @RestDelete} / {@code @RestPatch} / {@code @RestOptions}
1228    * annotation in the method-override chain.
1229    *
1230    * @param name The annotation property name (e.g. {@code "converters"}, {@code "guards"}).
1231    * @return A stream of {@link AnnotationInfo} entries in parent-to-child order, never {@code null}.
1232    */
1233   Stream<AnnotationInfo<?>> getRestOpAnnotationsForProperty(String name) {
1234      var annotations = getRestOpAnnotations();
1235      var cutoff = annotations.size();
1236      for (var i = 0; i < annotations.size(); i++) {
1237         if (resolveCdl(annotations.get(i).getStringArray("noInherit").orElse(StringUtils.EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY)).anyMatch(name::equalsIgnoreCase)) {
1238            cutoff = i + 1;
1239            break;
1240         }
1241      }
1242      return rstream(annotations.subList(0, cutoff));
1243   }

1274   /**
1275    * Startup-fail: validates that when the effective observability attribute for this op is {@code "true"},
1276    * at least one real backend ({@link org.apache.juneau.rest.server.metrics.MetricsRecorder} or
1277    * {@link org.apache.juneau.rest.server.tracing.TracerHook}) is registered.
1278    *
1279    * <p>
1280    * Called once during construction.  The resource-level check in {@link RestContext#checkObservabilityBackendPresent()}
1281    * already fires for {@code @Rest(observability="true")}; this companion fires for individual
1282    * {@code @RestOp(observability="true")} overrides that elevate a single op into strict mode.
1283    */
1284   private void checkOpObservabilityBackendPresent() {
1285      var attr = observabilityAttr.get();
1286      if (neqic("true", attr))
1287         return;
1288      var bs = beanStore();
1289      var recorder = bs.getBean(org.apache.juneau.rest.server.metrics.MetricsRecorder.class).orElse(null);
1290      var tracer = bs.getBean(org.apache.juneau.rest.server.tracing.TracerHook.class).orElse(null);
1291      boolean hasRecorder = recorder != null && !(recorder instanceof org.apache.juneau.rest.server.metrics.NoOpMetricsRecorder);
1292      boolean hasTracer = tracer != null && !(tracer instanceof org.apache.juneau.rest.server.tracing.NoOpTracerHook);
1293      if (!hasRecorder && !hasTracer)
1294         throw new InternalServerError(
1295            "@RestOp(observability=\"true\") is set on " + context.getResourceClass().getSimpleName() + "." + method.getName()
1296            + " but no MetricsRecorder or TracerHook @Bean is registered. "
1297            + "Either wire a backend or change observability to \"\" (inherit) or \"false\" (opt-out).");
1298   }

1314               return o(resolved);

1316      }
1317      return oe();
1318   }

1320   private List<MediaType> collectAnnotationMediaTypes(String attr) {
1321      var result = new ArrayList<MediaType>();
1322      var vr = varResolver();
1323      // Class-level @Rest(consumes|produces) first (when inheritance is allowed), then op-level overrides append.
1324      if (isInherited(attr)) {
1325         for (var ai : restContext().getRestAnnotations())
1326            appendResolvedMediaTypes(ai, attr, vr, result);
1327      }
1328      for (var ai : getRestOpAnnotations())
1329         appendResolvedMediaTypes(ai, attr, vr, result);
1330      return result;
1331   }

1333   private static void appendResolvedMediaTypes(AnnotationInfo<?> ai, String attr, VarResolver vr, List<MediaType> result) {
1334      var arr = ai.getStringArray(attr).orElse(null);
1335      if (arr == null)
1336         return;
1337      for (var s : arr) {
1338         if (isNotEmpty(s)) {
1339            var resolved = vr.resolve(s);
1340            if (!resolved.isEmpty())
1341               result.add(MediaType.of(resolved));
1342         }
1343      }
1344   }

1346   private static String httpMethodFromAnnotation(Annotation a, VarResolver vr) {
1347      if (a instanceof RestGet)
1348         return "get";
1349      if (a instanceof RestPut)
1350         return "put";
1351      if (a instanceof RestPost)
1352         return "post";
1353      if (a instanceof RestDelete)
1354         return "delete";
1355      if (a instanceof RestPatch)
1356         return "patch";
1357      if (a instanceof RestOptions)
1358         return "options";
1359      if (a instanceof RestOp a2) {
1360         var m = vr.resolve(a2.method());
1361         if (ine(m))
1362            return m;
1363         var s = vr.resolve(a2.value());
1364         if (s != null) {
1365            s = s.trim();
1366            if (!s.isEmpty()) {
1367               var i = s.indexOf(' ');
1368               return i == -1 ? s : s.substring(0, i).trim();
1369            }
1370         }
1371      }
1372      return null;
1373   }

1399    *
1400    * @param method The Java method this context represents. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
1401    * @param context The owning {@link RestContext}. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
1402    * @param resourceSupplier Supplier that returns the invocation target for this operation.
1403    * @throws ServletException If context could not be created.
1404    */

1409   /**
1410    * Context constructor.
1411    *
1412    * @param builder The builder for this object.
1413    * @throws ServletException If context could not be created.
1414    */
1415   private RestOpContext(Builder builder) throws ServletException {
1416      super(builder);
1417
1418      try {
1419         // Capture the annotation work-list before the builder becomes eligible for GC.
1420         appliedAnnotations = builder.getApplied();
1421
1422         context = builder.restContext;
1423         method = builder.restMethod;
1424         resourceSupplier = builder.restResourceSupplier;
1425
1426         mi = MethodInfo.of(method).accessible();
1427
1428         var bs = new BasicBeanStore(context.getBootstrapBeanStore());
1429         bs.addBean(RestOpContext.class, this);
1430         bs.addBean(Method.class, method);
1431         bs.addBean(AnnotationWorkList.class, appliedAnnotations);
1432         opBeanStore = bs;
1433
1434         bs.add(MarshallingContext.class, getMarshallingContext());
1435         bs.add(RestConverter[].class, getConverters());
1436         bs.add(EncoderSet.class, getEncoders());
1437         bs.add(RestGuard[].class, getGuards());
1438         bs.add(JsonSchemaGenerator.class, getJsonSchemaGenerator());
1439         bs.add(ParserSet.class, getParsers());
1440         bs.add(HttpPartParser.class, getPartParser());
1441         bs.add(HttpPartSerializer.class, getPartSerializer());
1442         bs.add(SerializerSet.class, getSerializers());
1443
1444      // Inject @Value-annotated env-driven defaults onto this RestOpContext instance so that the
1445      // memoizer lambdas (defaultCharset, maxInput) read fully resolved values when first invoked.
1446      ClassInfo.of(this).inject(this, bs);
1447
1448      // Startup-fail check: if this op (or its resource) declares observability="true" but neither
1449      // MetricsRecorder nor TracerHook is wired, fail fast with a precise error.
1450      checkOpObservabilityBackendPresent();
1451
1452      // The 6 formerly-eager scalar fields are now memoized; no eagerness needed here.
1453      // Pre-warm httpMethod so it is in the memoizer cache for immediate use by compareTo/match.
1454      httpMethod.get();
1455
1456      // Fail servlet init (not the first request) if a concrete @Request bean parameter has a getter with no matching
1457      // setter or no public no-arg constructor; the arg is rebuilt lazily with the invoker.
1458      for (var pi : mi.getParameters())
1459         org.apache.juneau.rest.server.arg.RequestBeanArg.create(pi, appliedAnnotations);
1460
1461         var pm = pathMatchers.get();
1462         bs.add(UrlPathMatcher[].class, pm);
1463         bs.addBean(UrlPathMatcher.class, pm.length > 0 ? pm[0] : null);
1464
1465      } catch (Exception e) {
1466         throw new ServletException(e);
1467      }
1468   }

1470   /*
1471    * compareTo() method is used to keep SimpleMethods ordered in the RestCallRouter list.
1472    * It maintains the order in which matches are made during requests.
1473    */
1474   @Override /* Overridden from Comparable */
1475   public int compareTo(RestOpContext o) {
1476      int c;
1477
1478      var pm = pathMatchers.get();
1479      var opm = o.pathMatchers.get();
1480      for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(pm.length, opm.length); i++) {
1481         c = pm[i].compareTo(opm[i]);
1482         if (c != 0)
1483            return c;
1484      }
1485
1486      c = cmp(o.hierarchyDepth.get(), hierarchyDepth.get());
1487      if (c != 0)
1488         return c;
1489
1490      c = cmp(o.requiredMatchers.get().length, requiredMatchers.get().length);
1491      if (c != 0)
1492         return c;
1493
1494      c = cmp(o.optionalMatchers.get().length, optionalMatchers.get().length);
1495      if (c != 0)
1496         return c;
1497
1498      c = cmp(o.getGuards().length, getGuards().length);
1499
1500      if (c != 0)
1501         return c;
1502
1503      c = cmp(method.getName(), o.method.getName());
1504      if (c != 0)
1505         return c;
1506
1507      c = cmp(method.getParameterCount(), o.method.getParameterCount());
1508      if (c != 0)
1509         return c;
1510
1511      for (var i = 0; i < method.getParameterCount(); i++) {
1512         c = cmp(method.getParameterTypes()[i].getName(), o.method.getParameterTypes()[i].getName());
1513         if (c != 0)
1514            return c;
1515      }
1516
1517      c = cmp(method.getReturnType().getName(), o.method.getReturnType().getName());
1518      if (c != 0)
1519         return c;
1520
1521      // Declaring-class tie-breaker: keeps compareTo consistent with equals()/hashCode() (which key off method
1522      // identity) for two ops whose methods share the same signature but differ by declaring class.  Only affects
1523      // ordering that was previously a zero-tie, so it makes tie-break stability deterministic rather than changing
1524      // any non-tied dispatch precedence.
1525      c = cmp(method.getDeclaringClass().getName(), o.method.getDeclaringClass().getName());
1526      if (c != 0)
1527         return c;
1528
1529      return 0;
1530   }

1885         var serializer = createPartSerializer((Class<? extends HttpPartSerializer>)schema.getSerializer(), getPartSerializer());
1886            pm = new ResponsePartMeta(HEADER, schema, serializer);

1934   private UrlPathMatch matchPattern(RestSession call) {
1935      for (var pp : pathMatchers.get()) {
1936         var pm = pp.match(call.getUrlPath());
1937         if (pm != null)
1938            return pm;
1939      }
1940      return null;
1941   }

1943   /**
1944    * Whether this operation's path pattern matches the specified call.
1945    *
1946    * <p>
1947    * Unlike {@link #match(RestSession)}, this neither runs the matchers nor caches the path match on the session, so
1948    * it can be asked of any operation without disturbing the one about to run.
1949    *
1950    * @param session The call to check.
1951    * @return <jk>true</jk> if the path pattern matches.
1952    */
1953   boolean matchesPath(RestSession session) {
1954      return nn(matchPattern(session));
1955   }
1956
1957   /**
1958    * Identifies if this method can process the specified call.
1959    *
1960    * <p>
1961    * To process the call, the following must be true:
1962    * <ul>
1963    *    <li>Path pattern must match.
1964    *    <li>Matchers (if any) must match.
1965    * </ul>
1966    *
1967    * @param session The call to check.
1968    * @return
1969    *    One of the following values:
1970    *    <ul>
1971    *       <li><c>0</c> - Path doesn't match.
1972    *       <li><c>1</c> - Path matched but matchers did not.
1973    *       <li><c>2</c> - Matches.
1974    *    </ul>
1975    */
1976   protected int match(RestSession session) {
1977
1978      var pm = matchPattern(session);
1979
1980      if (pm == null)
1981         return 0;
1982
1983      var rm = requiredMatchers.get();
1984      var om = optionalMatchers.get();
1985      if (rm.length == 0 && om.length == 0) {
1986         session.urlPathMatch(pm);  // Cache so we don't have to recalculate.
1987         return 2;
1988      }
1989
1990      try {
1991         var req = session.getRequest();
1992
1993         // If the method implements matchers, test them.
1994         for (var m : rm)
1995            if (! m.matches(req))
1996               return 1;
1997         if (om.length > 0) {
1998            var matches = false;
1999            for (var m : om)
2000               matches |= m.matches(req);
2001            if (! matches)
2002               return 1;
2003      }
2004
2005         session.urlPathMatch(pm);  // Cache so we don't have to recalculate.
2006         return 2;
2007      } catch (Exception e) {
2008         throw new InternalServerError(e);
2009      }
2010   }
